newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical shares fully taken.
newsitem.headline: Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical shares fully taken.

text.p: Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Corp Ltd (TZXP) said on Monday all 80 million of its placement shares had been subscribed.
It said in a statement that shares for its initial public offering on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) at US$0.68 per share had met with good institutional demand.
The company is also offering 20 million shares to the public. The closing date of the invitation is June 25.
TZXP is the first company from China to seek a primary listing on the SES.
